posts.author: Kamikoto10
posts.body:
Hi, I've been trying to find some interiors for a horror game I'm making for Uni in RMXP but the problem is even the ones I have to pay for don't feel exactly like what I want. If you've heard of corpse party, I'm thinking that kind of style. Not necessarily an abandoned house interior, but a bit run down, or if not then like antique looking. This
School tileset
I found looks really good, but it's not a house so I'm not sure I can use it.
I also found stuff like
This
and
this
but I'm not too sure about them. I guess im imagining something that has peeling wallpaper etc. There was some stuff i found online but i don't know where to find the tileset they came from. Stuff like this
So yeah, just wondering if there's any tilesets that can match this kind of style. The corpse party kind of style of a run down building but a house like some of the pictures I've provided. Obviously free would be best as it's scary to pay for something I may not be happy with, but if it looks good then I am find with paying a little bit. Thanks in advance!!

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Since you are looking for XP stuff, the recommendations in the previous post won't help at all unless you own other makers as well and are good at converting tiles.
You'll probably won't find something plug and play but have to merge existing tileset, but honestly, that is really doable and will help you a lot.
Using color grading (either the whole game or just your tileset in the graphic program) and fogs will also go a long way.
This author has a lot of different resources for schools and mansions that you can combine, also some horror-eske sepearate tiles:
ドット絵世界―タイルセット
ゲーム用の素材配布サイトです。RPGツクール以外にもウディタ（WOLF RPGエディター）等でお使いいただけます。
yms.main.jp

Lune's Resources
